exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-13T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix edit-
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: edit-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'

exec card create 'Target task'
exec card create 'Blocking task'
exec card create 'Contained child'

exec card edit edit-3 --parent edit-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/attach.txt

# Every requested metadata and graph change commits under one revision.
exec card --json edit edit-1 --type workstream --priority 1 --summary 'Program contract.' --label core --depends-on edit-2
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/edited.json

# A late validation failure rolls back earlier changes in the same request.
! exec card edit edit-1 --label leaked --parent missing
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/missing-parent.txt
exec card --json show edit-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/shown.json

exec card edit edit-3 --parent=
exec card --json show edit-3
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/detached.json
